title: Bertillon anthropometric record
alt: Front and back of an anthropometric identification card combining portrait photographs, bodily measurements, handwritten categories, and identifying marks.
caption: An anthropometric record associated with Alphonse Bertillon's identification system.
teachingUse: Shows how photographs, bodily measurements, categories, and identity records can become one administrative apparatus.
